Internal: a sheet's blank text cells, read as a CSV file's are

Source: R/io.R
dot-jst_sheet_blank_text.Rd

Ruling R34 (Jeff, Session 389: "Let's go with your recommendation on the excel issue."). readxl reads every blank cell of a sheet as missing – an empty cell, a cell holding an empty string, and a cell holding only spaces, whose spaces its XML parser drops before readxl sees them, under every option (trim_ws = FALSE, na = character(0)) – so a text variable's blank cells loaded as missing, where the same cells in a CSV file are the <blank> category, counted as valid (Cross-cutting 7 (3): a blank is reported, never assumed missing; the (S362) item). They become empty strings here, so a sheet's text variable reads as a CSV file's does (.jst_csv_type_columns()):

  • a variable of words gets "" in its blank cells, and so does one whose values are T and F standing alone, kept as written;

  • a variable whose values are all numbers, or the words TRUE and FALSE, stored as text keeps them missing, as a CSV file's variable of numbers does, a variable kept as text for a leading zero or a long number among them, and so does one the note on a few cells names;

  • a text = variable gets "", being read as written.

Cells na = names stay missing: with na = given, the variables are read again with na = "" alone, and only the cells missing in that read are blank; na = "" itself keeps every blank cell missing. The spaces cannot be recovered, so a cell of spaces becomes an empty string, the one <blank> category either way. An Excel error cell (#N/A), which readxl also reads as missing, becomes <blank> in a variable of words with them (a CSV file holds it as the word #N/A, also valid).

Usage

.jst_sheet_blank_text(df, text_pos, marker_pos, na, reread)

Arguments

df

The sheet as read.

text_pos

Positions named in text =.

marker_pos

Positions the note on a few cells names (.jst_marker_columns()).

na

jload()'s na =, or NULL.

reread

A function of positions giving those variables read again as text with na = "" alone.

Value

df, its blank text cells empty strings.
